title: Do not evaluate applicants using specified criminal records
summary: A housing provider may not evaluate an applicant based on arrests or charges without conviction, expunged or pardoned convictions, legally nullified convictions, juvenile delinquency adjudications, or sealed records, before or after a conditional offer.
exemptions: Owner-occupied premises with no more than four dwelling units are outside the act's definition of rental dwelling unit.

title: Do not publish categorical criminal-record exclusion advertisements
quoted_span:
A housing provider shall not knowingly or
purposefully publish, or cause to be published, any housing advertisement that
explicitly provides that the housing provider will not consider any applicant
who has been arrested or convicted of one or more crimes or offenses
summary: A housing provider may not knowingly or purposefully publish an advertisement explicitly stating that applicants arrested or convicted of crimes will not be considered, except for the two specified criminal-history categories.
exemptions: Owner-occupied premises with no more than four dwelling units are outside the act's definition of rental dwelling unit.

title: Do not require drug or alcohol tests or request treatment-facility consent
quoted_span:
A housing provider shall not require an applicant
to submit to a drug or alcohol test, or request the applicant’s consent to
obtain information from a drug abuse treatment facility.
